title: Shattered Cosmic Mask
description: A close-up portrait of a purple-skinned woman with closed eyes, her face partially cracked like porcelain. A cosmic galaxy and nebulae explode from the broken right side of her head while orange molten substance drips down her face and neck. Her left hand, also purple, holds the cracking mask-like portion of her face as purple shards float away.
prompt: surreal portrait of a purple-skinned woman with closed eyes, her face cracking like a porcelain mask on the right side, vibrant colorful galaxy and nebulae pouring out from the broken half of her head, bright orange molten liquid dripping down her face and neck, her purple hand holding the cracking mask, purple shards floating in space, dramatic purple beam of light from above, cosmic background with stars and nebulae, highly detailed digital painting
